scope: Independent read-only pre-execution source and mathematics/control review. A pass permits only the frozen finite operation; it is not a result or coverage qualification.
findings: The amended fixed three-call sequence matches the unchanged CLI: public starts 0,1,2 for free; free theta followed by public starts 0,1 for constrained fits, with 120 iterations per start and no retry.

The driver binds unchanged C/header sources and reused supervisor to the base and final commits, binds the witness to both commits, and binds exact plan, independent review, executable and observation identities before target extraction.
Target extraction selects the unique aggregate n=252000 point fields and availability metadata. It does not use truth/error fields in targets, objectives, starts or fit selection.

All 252000 original binary records are converted using 17 significant digits and compared bit-for-bit both during conversion and after closed-file reread. Original index order, actual dt/current/voltage and both representations are retained by hashes.
Q uses --fixed 6 log(Q); current SOC uses the existing entering-state/charge/Q link. The free theta is a numerical start, not another observation or posterior penalty.

The immutable prior supervisor provides exact-child wait4 resources, combined output limits and termination. The driver additionally accounts for total wall/RSS, derived output, scratch CSV, per-fit/final hashes and attempted-versus-observed launches.

Malformed essential values, source mutation, child failure or resource breach stop remaining calls. Finite nonconverged candidates remain explicitly labeled and do not trigger extra starts or retries.

Raw undamped Gram/scales are retained without inversion or eigenvalue threshold adoption. The linked-SOC chart is labeled separately. Signed objective differences are reported without a statistical or voltage cutoff; constrained-better-than-free is explicitly flagged.
Exclusive attempt reservation and bounded failure receipt preserve prelaunch failures and reject output reuse.

qualification_evidence_read.scope: Author-recorded fabricated Python-only conversion, target uniqueness, argv, finite/nonfinite parse and prelaunch receipt/no-overwrite checks. Reviewer read script and receipt without importing or running them.

limits: This is a new bounded full-history likelihood control, not a rerun of the recursive learner, a prior-conditioned posterior or a calibration test.
A high-cost local constrained candidate cannot globally exclude a target. A constrained candidate below free establishes an incomplete free baseline and permits no automatic retry.
Any subsequent local-SD reduction must use the appropriate free chart and full coordinate scales, expose conditioning and numerical failure, and avoid cutoff/pseudoinverse repair.
Compilation and help validate interfaces only. Source review does not predict optimizer convergence or that execution will finish within its frozen budget.
